info.title: Fourthwall Universal API
info.description: Manage Fourthwall products, orders, promotions, and webhooks

post.description: Creates a new promotion in Fourthwall.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: Promotion type. Supported values: SHOP_SINGLE, SHOP_MULTI, MEMBERSHIPS_SINGLE, MEMBERSHIPS_MULTI.

codes[].description: Array of promotion codes for multi-code variants.

discount.description: Discount object. For shop promotions use either a fixed amount discount or percentage discount. For membership promotions use percentage discount.

requirements.description: Requirements object. For memberships, set newMembersOnly. For shop promotions, minimumOrderValue may be provided.

subscriptionType.description: Membership subscription type selector for membership promotion variants.

tiers.description: Membership tiers selector object for membership promotion variants.

appliesToProducts.description: Selected products object for shop promotion variants. productIds is required if this object is provided.

limits.description: Promotion limits object for shop promotion variants. oneUsePerCustomer is required if this object is provided.

type.description: Which items or order scope the promotion applies to.

oneUsePerCustomer.description: Whether each customer can use the promotion only once.

minimumOrderValue.description: Minimum order value required to apply the promotion.

usageCount.description: How many times the promotion has been used.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
